sentences.englishText: The International Hotel offers many services including a boutique, a sauna, and a swimming pool.
sentences.turkishText: Uluslararası Otel; butik, sauna ve yüzme havuzu dahil birçok hizmet sunmaktadır.

sentences.englishText: Guests can exchange currency at the bureau, buy flowers, or enjoy meals at the restaurant.
sentences.turkishText: Konuklar büroda döviz bozdurabilir, çiçek satın alabilir veya restoranda yemeklerin tadını çıkarabilirler.

sentences.englishText: The hotel has a car park for safety and a hair salon open for both men and women.
sentences.turkishText: Otel güvenlik için bir otoparka ve hem kadınlar hem de erkekler için açık bir kuaföre sahiptir.

enrichment.summary: The International Hotel offers many services including a boutique, a sauna, and a swimming pool. Guests can exchange currency at the bureau, buy flowers, or enjoy meals at the restaurant.
